disclaimer.title: This app is not medical advice
disclaimer.intro: Qbit Nutrition is a tool for keeping a personal food log. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition.

estimates.body: Calories and nutrients calculated from a photo are approximations produced with the help of an AI model you chose. They can be wrong, sometimes by a lot. Do not rely on them for medical decisions, such as insulin dosing or managing an allergy.

targets.body: Suggested calorie and nutrient targets come from standard formulas for healthy adults. They do not take your medical history into account.

professional.body: Consult a doctor or a registered dietitian before changing your diet, especially if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, under 18, have a medical condition, or have or have had an eating disorder.

allergens.body: Never use it to decide whether a food is safe for you.

disclaimer.closing: If tracking food causes you distress, stop using the app and seek support from a health professional.

disclaimer.declinedBody: Qbit Nutrition can only be used after you accept the health notice. Nothing has been saved.

under_18.title: Targets are not suggested under 18
under_18.body: Needs change a lot while growing, and a general formula can mislead. A doctor or registered dietitian can give you targets that fit. You can still log your meals here.

pregnant.title: Targets are not suggested during pregnancy
pregnant.body: Needs change during pregnancy and a general formula does not cover them. Talk to your doctor or a registered dietitian. You can still log your meals, and you can enter targets they give you.

breastfeeding.title: Targets are not suggested while breastfeeding
breastfeeding.body: Needs change while breastfeeding and a general formula does not cover them. Talk to your doctor or a registered dietitian. You can still log your meals, and you can enter targets they give you.

below_minimum.title: This goal is below the minimum
below_minimum.body: With your details, this goal and pace would give fewer calories than the minimum daily energy of {{minimum}} kcal, so no targets are suggested. Choose a different goal or pace, change the minimum, or enter your own targets.

calc.title: How this is calculated
calc.intro: Targets come from published formulas and guidelines. Each value shows where it comes from. They are general guidance for healthy adults, not medical advice.
calc.english: Titles, quotes and notes of the sources are shown in English, as published.

status.sourced_range: A point chosen inside a published range

minimum.warning: A lower minimum lets the app suggest lower targets. Talk to a doctor or registered dietitian before eating very little.
